description: This PHP file handles the rendering of a report column total view in a vtiger CRM module. It includes setup for dependencies, retrieves report data based on request parameters, and assigns data to a Smarty template for display.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template class instance used to assign variables and render the ReportColumnsTotal.tpl template.

classes.name: Reports
classes.description: Represents report logic, used to retrieve and process report data for display.

methods.name: sgetColumntoTotalSelected
methods.description: Retrieves total columns for a specific report with selected modules.

methods.name: sgetColumntoTotal
methods.description: Retrieves total columns for a report based on primary and secondary modules.
